subject: gk
question: Kongampattu AV Murugaiyan, a _________ exponent, was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**thavil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kongampattu AV Murugaiyan is an exponent of the **thavil**.
 
• The **thavil** is a traditional percussion instrument from South India, particularly used in **Carnatic music**.
 
• It is primarily used in temple, folk, and classical music contexts, often accompanying the **nadaswaram**.
 
• The **thavil** is known for its distinctive, resonant sound and requires significant skill to play.
 
• Kongampattu AV Murugaiyan was awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2022 for his contributions to music, highlighting his expertise and dedication to this instrument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dholak**__

 __
 
• The **dholak** is a two-headed hand drum widely used in folk music and traditional dances across India.
 
• It is commonly used in **bhajans, qawwalis, and film music**.
 
• The **dholak** has a simple construction but produces a variety of sounds depending on the playing technique.
 
 
 
• **Sitar**__
 __
 
• The **sitar** is a plucked stringed instrument used mainly in **Hindustani classical music**.
 
• It has a rich, resonant sound and is known for its complex structure with **sympathetic strings**.
 
• Famous sitar players include **Ravi Shankar** and **Anoushka Shankar**.
 
 
 
• **Guitar**__
 
 
• The **guitar** is a popular stringed instrument used in a wide range of music genres, from classical to rock.
 
• It typically has six strings and is played by strumming or plucking.
 
• Famous guitarists include **Jimi Hendrix** and **Eric Clapton**.
